story.title: In 30 seconds.
beats: It all started in Mar del Plata: at 17 I built my first product, a games website.
I am self-taught: I read a lot and study online.
I taught JavaScript and React, and teaching strengthened my basics.
Today I build AI products end to end, like CompliA.
New challenges drive me: boosting businesses and automating hard processes, in any industry.

seed.title: My first product: a games website
text: At 17 I built my first product, a games website. It changed my life and opened the road I am on.

tach.title: A digital wallet, end to end
text: Working remotely, I built the back office, the landing page and the app of a digital wallet, on web and mobile.

ada.title: Teaching people to code
text: I taught JavaScript and React: projects, hello worlds and students starting from zero.
Teaching strengthened my basics and taught me to explain technical ideas clearly.

tuenti.title: Gamification at Tuenti
text: I started working on Tuenti: interactive and reward mechanics, such as the Tuenti roulette and the referral system.

dash.title: Measuring what works
text: I built a dashboard to measure Tuenti's data: referrals, recurrence and gamification.

award.title: Special Recognition from Tsoft
text: An internal Special Recognition from Tsoft, with a message and a gesture from the People team.

ai.title: AI products and a team that grows
text: I designed and built CompliA, the RAG assistant of Telefónica's compliance portal, now in internal production.
I built Supernova Eventos and trained colleagues to raise the team's level. In April, an in-person day with clients in Buenos Aires.

own.title: Boosting businesses and automating the hard parts
text: Eclipse and a lab of demos and trailers: my own products, in any industry.
